title: Flora Typica No. 7
description: A stone-drawn botanical pulled in a single ink pass. Petal hatching was scraped back by hand before etching — the seventh state of an ongoing flora study.

title: Print-born Interfaces
description: Twelve interface sketches treated as plates: arches, tabs and buttons registered like a four-colour run. Sample series, fictional plates.

title: Crosshatch Studies
description: Notebook pages on line density — how many strokes before a grey becomes a black. Margins annotated in Space Mono.

title: Object 14 / Vessel
description: A vessel drawn as if it were a specimen: front elevation, contour, and a halftone shadow that never quite lands.

title: Signal / Noise
description: Poster study in two screens. The second screen was deliberately misregistered by 2mm — the noise is the point.

title: Ephemera Collection
description: Tickets, wrappers, and offcuts bound into a working archive. A sample index of the collective's paper scraps.

title: Litho Loop 03
description: A looping motion study built from three printed frames, scanned and re-sequenced. Grain is preserved frame to frame.

title: Garden of Marks
description: An early screen print: a garden made only of marks — dots, dashes, and a sunflower that refuses to be round.
